title: Running a formula with more than one letter

ask.text: Let it settle and read it.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Each charge goes to its own socket, not to whichever one is nearest.
The rise has come out at 32. The run has not been seated yet.

worldFraming.text: Two names, two sockets, one deck: a rise and a run, and neither takes the other's charge.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: Two names, two sockets, one deck: a rise and a run, and neither takes the other's charge.

ask.text: Stack a load in r that reads 94 when the socket holds {at}.

hints.text: Two pans across the Sill, and a deck that still has to reach.
A count, a power, a fixed weight — any of them will do, so long as it reads true at that charge.
Seat {at} in whatever you build and it has to come out at 94.
